general.title: Cockpit switches
general.intro: Switches the Stream Deck may press and show — Korry buttons, toggles and knobs you have no hardware for. Each row names one ProSim switch; the app writes it directly, nothing else is needed.

enable.label: Cockpit switches
enable.hint: Lets Stream Deck keys press the switches below. Needs the Command API (Settings → Setup).
enable.more: Off: the keys show the state but every press is refused.

row.stateHint: What ProSim reports for this switch right now. Lit means the key's lamp is on.

dataRef.label: ProSim switch
dataRef.hint: Picked from ProSim's own switch list. Only switches (S_…), no circuit breakers.
dataRef.unknown: {0} is not in the switch list — pick it again. The row is skipped until then.
dataRef.sourceShipped: List from the shipped catalogue (ProSim not connected yet).

id.label: Key id
id.hint: What a key sends: cockpit.press {"id":"…"}. Letters, digits and underscores. Filled in from the switch; change it before you build keys.

name.label: Key title
name.hint: The text on top of the key face, for example LEAK MEAS B.

look.label: Look
look.hint: How the key draws the switch.

press.label: Press does
press.hint: Toggle flips between the first two positions. Momentary presses and releases (push buttons that spring back). Cycle steps through all positions; a long press steps back.

upperLegend.label: Upper legend
upperLegend.hint: Text in the upper lamp (FAULT, AVAIL). Empty hides the text.

lowerLegend.label: Lower legend
lowerLegend.hint: Text in the lower lamp (OFF, ON).

upperIndicator.label: Upper lamp from
upperIndicator.hint: A system.indicators.I_… dataref; the lamp is lit while it is not zero. Empty: the upper lamp never lights.

lowerIndicator.label: Lower lamp from
lowerIndicator.hint: A system.indicators.I_… dataref. Empty: lit while the switch is pushed (not zero).

row.upperColorHint: Amber for FAULT, green for AVAIL.
row.lowerColorHint: White for OFF, blue for a selected ON. Knobs and toggles use it for the active position.
row.bezelColorHint: Ring around the button. Empty keeps the grey bezel; the leak valves use blue, green and yellow.
row.positionsNone: ProSim lists no positions — the switch is a plain number.
row.pressHint: Presses this switch now through the app, with the saved rows. Watch ProSim react before you build a key.

showUnlitLegend.label: Legend while dark
showUnlitLegend.hint: On: the legend stays faintly readable while the lamp is dark, like a real engraved Korry. Off: nothing shows until the lamp lights — the word only appears when lit.

list.title: Add switches
list.hint: One line per switch; ▸ shows the rare fields
list.addLeakValves: Add the three leak measurement valves
list.duplicate: Two rows share the id "{0}" — a key would press the first one only.
